turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Who decided on the zero, and did anyone hear Owen before it went in?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for agreeing to meet in person.
You didn't answer me, Hale. Who entered the zero?
I'll admit I looked you up. Your firm's appellate record is remarkable.
Flattery won't get you anywhere. Was Owen heard before that mark went in, yes or no?
Someone with your training will appreciate that I'm simply following the evidence. I expect you'd do the same in my position.
I'm not in your position. If there's evidence, put it on the table.
